auditMetadata.reportTitle: Architecture Explorer Phase 2.2 Original Acceptance Criteria Preservation & Final Register Reconciliation

f6TypeScriptReevaluation.originalCriteria: TypeScript compilation (tsc --noEmit) must pass with zero type errors across explorer/ codebase.
f6TypeScriptReevaluation.reevaluationDecision: Reclassified F6 from VERIFIED_CLOSED to IMPLEMENTED_UNVERIFIED. While src/types/explorer.ts has 0 errors, whole-codebase tsc --noEmit exits with code 1 due to 532 errors across components and test fixtures, failing F6's original un-weakened acceptance criteria.
